title: Socials
description: Single source of truth for profile / social presence. Powers JSON-LD `Person.sameAs` (entity-graph seed for Google), IndieWeb `<link rel="me">` tags, and footer/contact/about surfaces. URL-deduped, ordered, visible/featured flags. Lifted 2026-05-16 from rahmanef.com; sanitized: token-based admin gate swapped for `requireAdmin(ctx)`; dropped baked-in 14-platform rahmanef seed — `seed` now takes items via args so each adopter ships their own canonical list.
